articles.title: Darius Acuff Jr. and Cameron Boozer Battling for Kalshi Rookie of the Year Award
articles.summary: Two traders named Darius Acuff Jr. and Cameron Boozer are competing for Kalshi's Rookie of the Year award, presumably by racking up wins on the platform's event contracts. If either of them has figured out an edge in political or financial prediction markets, their trading patterns could signal where sharp money is actually flowing instead of where the crowd thinks it's going.

articles.title: Packers vs Rams Prediction Market Promos & Combos
articles.summary: Sportsbooks are stacking promos and combo bets ahead of the Packers-Rams matchup, the kind of aggressive marketing that only happens when the juice is tight and books need volume. That means sharp bettors should assume the consensus line is already cooked, and any edge worth finding lives in the less obvious prop combinations.

articles.title: Polymarket launches public contracts for AI compute pricing through 2028
articles.summary: Polymarket is letting people trade contracts that bet on the price of AI compute over the next four years, essentially gambling on whether GPUs and cloud processing stay expensive or get cheap. If the market works, it creates a real-money mechanism for pricing something that's otherwise trapped in analyst reports and venture capital opinions.

articles.title: Where Every League Stands on Kalshi, Polymarket
articles.summary: Sports leagues are finally taking public stances on whether they'll allow Kalshi and Polymarket to operate prediction markets on their games. If major leagues crack down, it chops off a significant revenue stream and user base for platforms that have built their entire pitch around real-money sports betting.

articles.title: Crypto.com’s Prediction Market Spinoff Feels Liquidity Crunch
articles.summary: Crypto.com spun off its prediction market platform and is now getting absolutely starved for liquidity, which is basically death for a betting venue where nobody wants to trade. When your order book is thinner than a startup's runway, you're watching the prediction market equivalent of a ghost town, and that's exactly what happens when volume dries up.

articles.title: 'Focker-In-Law' Rotten Tomatoes Score: Kalshi, Polymarket Traders Predict "Fock" Bottom Score
articles.summary: Traders on Kalshi and Polymarket are betting on where "Meet the Fockers" will bottom out on Rotten Tomatoes, apparently convinced the sequel's critical reception hasn't hit rock bottom yet. If the movie's score keeps tanking, it becomes a test case for whether prediction markets can accurately forecast cultural consensus before review aggregators settle on a final number.

articles.title: Prediction markets push OpenAI IPO expectations later into 2027
articles.summary: OpenAI is now expected to go public sometime later in 2027 instead of earlier in the year, according to prediction market data. If true, it delays when early bettors can cash out their positions and shifts the timeline for one of tech's most anticipated IPOs by several months.

articles.title: CME Group Eyes Growth as Prediction Markets Gain Strong Momentum
articles.summary: CME Group is positioning itself to capitalize on prediction markets as they transition from niche curiosity to legitimate financial infrastructure. If the largest U.S. derivatives exchange gets serious about this space, regulatory legitimacy and institutional money follow, which means better odds, deeper liquidity, and way less sketchy counterparties for everyone involved.

articles.title: SimpleSwap adds Polymarket trading to crypto platform
articles.summary: SimpleSwap, a no-KYC crypto exchange, is now letting users trade prediction market shares from Polymarket directly on its platform. This matters because it's another brick in the wall of integrating prediction markets into the broader crypto ecosystem, making it frictionless for degenerates to pivot from swapping shitcoins to betting on elections.

articles.title: Gold drops below $3,500; prediction markets price moderate year-end targets (XAUUSD:CUR:Commodity)
articles.summary: Gold just cracked below $3,500 an ounce, breaking through what looked like a pretty solid floor for the yellow metal. That matters because prediction markets are now pricing in a year-end target that's notably more pessimistic than the current spot price, which either means sophisticated traders expect further downside or they're being too cautious.

articles.title: Van Hollen Calls Senate Democratic Leader Race 'Wide Open' as Prediction Markets Favor Schumer
articles.summary: Senate Democrats are picking their next leader, and Van Hollen says it's anyone's game despite prediction markets heavily favoring Schumer to keep the role. The gap between political rhetoric and market odds creates an arbitrage opportunity if Van Hollen knows something the smart money doesn't.

articles.title: Los Angeles Lakers Announce Partnership with Kalshi
articles.summary: The Lakers just inked a deal with Kalshi, the CFTC-regulated prediction market platform, likely for sponsorship or official betting integration. This matters because it signals major sports leagues are finally comfortable going all-in on prediction markets instead of just tolerating them from the sidelines.
